Original TMD (Nguyen Minh et al., EMNLP 2022)
keep the one closest to t

InfoGAN: the paper's Table 6 settings, new embeddings.

Evaluation, identical for both: the authors' attack code (PWWS, TextFooler, BERT-Attack), 1000 test sentences, at most 30% of words changed, sentence similarity ≥ 0.84
BERT turns each sentence into 768 numbers
that summarise its meaning: a point in space.
The classifier only ever sees this point.
Clean sentences of one topic lie on a curved
band (the "manifold"); the GAN learns the bands.
An attack swaps a few words, so the point moves
off its band and the classifier is fooled.
closest of 30 guesses on a band;
a new pick on every query
the encoder maps it straight back
